blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bank of Commerce (BankCom), an affiliate of San Miguel Corp., grew its unaudited net income by 15 percent to P3.17 billion in the first nine months of 2026 as higher interest earnings offset a drop in non-interest income. On Thursday, the bank said it earned P2.75 billion in the same period last year. BankCom said gross revenue rose 15 percent to P10.70 billion.
